expected_transcript:
Sit with your feet on the floor or a cushion. Let your hands rest naturally—you may adjust anytime.

Listen to nearby sounds—the hum of air, a clock, or voices. Feel the steady support of your seat beneath you.

Pick one sound to focus on, like the quiet or a distant tone. When your mind drifts, simply return to that sound.

Notice how your body settles into the seat’s support. Let that steady sound guide you, like a quiet thread pulling you back when needed.

Observe your hands resting—light and open. If your thoughts shift, gently come back to the same sound you chose earlier.

Stay with the sound and the support beneath you. You can explore this quietly on your own now.

Whenever you like, shift your focus—but you can always return to the sound or the steady seat.

Listen again to the sounds around you. You may stretch your fingers slightly before opening your eyes.
